about.title: About me
about.subtitle: A Brazilian who wants to see the world and tell good stories.
about.portrait_alt: Pixel art portrait of Kauã — curly hair, green hood, and a backpack
about.bio_1: I'm Kauã, I'm 18, I was born and raised in Uberlândia, and today I live in Oxford with my family. It was the first big move of my life — and I know there is still a lot of world ahead.
about.bio_2: My education has always included a lot of self-directed learning. I started programming in 2022 and went through projects and experiences in marketing, sales, and technology that are now part of my story and what I learned along the way.
about.bio_3: Now I want to build @KauaArtx as a travel and real-life channel. Oxford is part of the story because it is where I am today, but it is not the limit of it.
about.bio_4: I want to discover countries, hear stories, put myself in new situations, and record it all without pretending every day is perfect. The plan is simple: live more and have good stories to tell.

loog.desc: Sales team of the AI-powered logistics platform: sales meetings, discovery, company research and qualification, follow-up, requirements gathering, and presentations.

facility.desc: My venture as an entrepreneur: we talk to the client, understand their operation, and deliver the tailor-made system that truly solves the problem.

diamond.desc: Campaigns for the high-end real estate market: Google Ads, Meta Ads, qualified lead generation, and creating business opportunities.

hlts.desc: I joined to run paid traffic and ended up solving a team bottleneck: I built from scratch a landing page system with lead capture and export that the company adopted in its daily work.

agencies.desc: Where it all started: managing paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads, lead generation, metrics analysis, reporting, and ROI optimization for clients across industries.

kadenduo.name: Kadenduo
kadenduo.desc: Sales prospecting automation: finds companies in any city in Brazil, separates those with and without a website, and organizes contacts ready for outreach.

finance_card.name: Finance Card
finance_card.desc: An educational digital bank I designed and built for a school fair: investment simulations, financial education, and even a platform to hire teachers. It got a lot of praise at the presentation.

null_forge.name: Null Forge
null_forge.desc: A free platform to help people getting started in programming — because good knowledge is shared knowledge.
